column1: # Forge types that are classes in Forge 1.20.1 and interfaces on Forge 26.2 and 26.3, read from the Forge jars named below.
# An old mod calls them with INVOKEVIRTUAL, and Retromod gives such a call the interface form. A running host is read
# first; this table answers only when the host cannot be read, as in an offline transform, and only for a Forge target
# at or above the row's version. NeoForge 26.x made no NeoForge 1.21.x class an interface, so it has no table.
# Columns: the first Minecraft version the row was checked on, and the type.
# Forge 1.20.1: forge-1.20.1-47.4.10-universal.jar, fmlcore, fmlloader, javafmllanguage, eventbus-6.0.5.jar, forgespi-7.0.1.jar.
# 26.2: forge-26.2-65.0.0-universal.jar, fmlcore, fmlloader, javafmllanguage-26.2-65.0.0.jar, eventbus-7.0.1.jar, forgespi-8.0.0.jar.
# 26.3: forge-26.3-66.1.2-universal.jar, fmlcore, fmlloader, javafmllanguage-26.3-66.1.2.jar, eventbus-7.0.6.jar, forgespi-8.0.0.jar.
